summary: Numeric input with decrease and increase buttons, arrow-key stepping, min and max, and locale-aware formatting.
whenToUse: Exact numbers within known bounds: approvals, columns, spacing steps, retry counts.
suffix for the unit (px, ms, %), format for currency or percent.
whenNotToUse: Identifiers that only look like numbers (zip codes, ids, phone numbers): use Input with inputMode numeric.
Rough values where position matters: use Slider.

dos.title: Set min and max
dos.text: Bounds disable the buttons at the edges and stop impossible values.

donts.title: Unit in the label and in the value
donts.text: Say it once, in the suffix: "Base spacing" with px, not "Base spacing (px)" plus px.

accessibility: Base UI NumberField: a text input with role textbox and aria-roledescription Number field; Arrow Up and Down step, Shift uses largeStep.
The decrease and increase buttons are named and disabled at min and max.
Inherits label, description and error from Field; invalid sets aria-invalid and a danger edge.
Values use tabular figures so digits do not jump while stepping.
contentGuidelines: Label names the quantity, the suffix names the unit.
Errors give the allowed range: "Use 1 to 5."
